newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore 1997 construction to top S$20 billion.
newsitem.headline: Singapore 1997 construction to top S$20 billion.

text.p: The total value of construction contracts in Singapore should reach Singapore $20 billion in 1997 and the outlook for the sector was bright, Koo Tsai Kee, Parliamentary Secretary for National Development, said on Tuesday.
"The local construction scene remains buoyant and local companies continue to expand into the regional construction market," Koo said in a speech.
He said S$9 billion of contracts had been awarded in the first half of the year and the Construction Industry Development Board expected S$11 billion to be awarded in the second half.
The S$20 billion forecast is 11 percent higher than the S$18 billion prediction for the year made in January.
